extension.valueString:
Frequency: Due every 3 years for all ages.
Risk factor screening for Hepatitis C is due   once for all patients who do not
already have   a diagnosis of hepatitis C.
 
Ask patients about:   IVDU, tattoos, blood transfusion prior to 1992,  
multiple sexual partners (>20), prior cocaine use.
 
Unexplained elevation in ALT may also be a   sign of Hepatitis C.

Frequency: Due every 1 year for all ages.
No recent screening for depression is recorded.  All patients should be
screened yearly for depression with a standard screening tool.
